thread.title: Close Update: Apple Rescues Stocks From Early Beat-Down

author: MT Newswires
title: Close Update: Apple Rescues Stocks From Early Beat-Down
text:
Shutterstock photo Wall Street's major averages clinched a positive close after a short-covering rebound in Apple ( AAPL ) spread across the tech sector and lifted the Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 into the plus column for the first time in four days. The Nasdaq outperformed with software and chipmakers taking the lead, driving the tech sector higher by 1.43% at the close.
Until Apple's rescue, stocks were losing altitude for the first part of the day as the fractured relationship between the US and China coupled with sluggish global economic growth and another Brexit defeat unleashed a 500 point loss in the blue chip index.
Apple shares fell to an eight-month low after a Chinese court granted Qualcomm ( QCOM ) an injunction against the tech-giant, banning the import and sale of nearly all iPhone models in China. The stock looked set for a fourth day of losses before racing higher after the company said it would appeal the decision and continue to sell iPhones in China in the meantime.
Data released at 10am ET had little impact on Wall Street even as the number of jobs available hit the second highest on record of 7.1 million from a revised 6.960 million in September. This now puts the number of available jobs 1.1 million over the number of available workers.
All eyes will be on tomorrow's inflation data that could factor into the Federal Reserve's decision whether to halt interest rate hikes next year. Wholesale prices are expected to remain unchanged in November while prices excluding the food and fuel sector will likely increase by just 0.1%.
Wall Street will also be focused on developments in the Huawei case as the CFO faces a bail hearing before a Canadian judge. Meng Wanzhou's continued detainment is being blamed for the deteriorating relationship between the US and China for which Beijing has said it will retaliate against the US and Canada.
